item.title: Full emergency declared as SpiceJet Delhi-Leh flight returns after engine failure
item.description: A full emergency was declared on Tuesday morning after a SpiceJet flight from Delhi to Leh reported an engine issue shortly after takeoff. The aircraft safely returned to the national capital, officials said. According to sources, the flight turned back following an “Engine Number 2 failure.” The Boeing 737, carrying around 150 passengers, landed safely in Delhi at approximately 6.45 am. item.description: Odisha’s critical minerals sector may expand significantly over the next seven years, with its value expected to rise from USD 8 billion in 2025 to USD 18–20 billion by 2032, according to a study by the Net Zero Energy Transition Association (NETRA). item.description: Indian Railways has announced a significant overhaul of onboard cleanliness rules to improve the passenger experience on long-distance trains, Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw said. item.title: Gold, silver see biggest surge in 3 weeks; check prices across major cities on February 24
item.description: Gold prices hovered close to the Rs 1.62 lakh mark across major Indian cities on February 24, while silver traded around Rs 3 lakh per kilogram, with minor variations between markets. Chennai recorded the highest gold price among the listed cities, while Mumbai, Kolkata, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Kerala and Pune shared the same rate.
